author: Forbes
description: Anthropic priced its highly anticipated initial public offering at $83 per share on Wednesday evening, valuing the AI giant behind the Claude chatbot at $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis. By the time trading began around noon, on Thursday, a share of Anthropic was worth $111.50, implying a fully diluted market cap of $2 trillion—a stock pop of 34%. But by the time the market closed at 4 p.m., the company’s share price had fallen to $97.17, leaving Anthropic with a fully diluted market cap of $1.8 trillion at the end of its first trading day. These three developments boosted the combined net worth of CEO Dario Amodei and his six cofounders by $63.7 billion, to an estimated $163 billion, or roughly $23.3 billion each. They also added a total of $14.4 billion to the fortunes of three billionaire investors who backed Anthropic early: former Google CEO Eric Schmidt, Dubai-based luxury real estate developer Hussain Sajwani and Estonian Skype cofounder and AI safety advocate Jaan Tallin
title: Meet The Biggest Billionaire Winners Of Anthropic’s IPO
